title: Courier handover with signed manifest
problem: There was no proof of which parcels the rider took when cash on delivery went missing.
now: Staff scan each courier's parcels, check count and cash, print a manifest to sign and mark them handed over.
steps: Choose Pathao and tick its parcels

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
